title: SelectDialog
description: Search a list in a dialog and confirm one or several choices.

usage.summary: Search and select from a list with its own dialog and confirmation flow.
useWhen: Choose one list item immediately or confirm several choices together.
Show a focused list of suggestions with a separate search task.

avoidWhen.when: Search several attributes in a results table or define conditions and ranges.
Pick a suggestion by typing from an inline field.
